title.zh: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
title.en: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss

current_state.zh: The U.S. House Ways and Means Committee advanced the bipartisan Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act 38-5, which would ease tax burdens on small crypto transactions and treat digital assets like other financial products, less than a day after the industry's market structure bill collapsed in the Senate.
current_state.en: The U.S. House Ways and Means Committee advanced the bipartisan Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act 38-5, which would ease tax burdens on small crypto transactions and treat digital assets like other financial products, less than a day after the industry's market structure bill collapsed in the Senate.
